items.title: BMW’s MINI launches locally made Countryman C in India at ₹47.5 lakh
items.summary: The petrol-powered sport utility vehicle is being manufactured at the company’s Chennai plant, marking the latest addition to MINI’s India lineup under local production.

items.title: Tata Motors confident of delivering industry-leading growth in FY27 despite global uncertainties: Chandrasekaran
items.summary: Chairman N Chandrasekaran said the company will continue to deepen collaboration with Jaguar Land Rover while investing in electrification, technology and manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: Porsche India opens largest dealership in Hyderabad, expands network to 14 sales touchpoints
items.summary: The centre adopts Porsche's global 'Destination Porsche' retail concept, offering an experience-led environment aimed at enhancing customer engagement with the brand beyond conventional vehicle retail.

items.title: BMW shares hit 2020 lows after China weakness and Iran war prompt profit warning
items.summary: Oliver Blume, CEO ​of Volkswagen, Europe's largest ​carmaker by sales, has ⁠warned that the traditional export model that buoyed Germany's auto industry for years no longer delivers.

items.title: BMW shares sink after profit warning highlights China and Iran risk
items.summary: German carmaker BMW's shares tumbled after a profit warning. The company cited challenges from China's weak car market and the Iran war. These issues are expected to affect BMW's targets for 2026. This development has also impacted other European carmakers. Analysts suggest this could be the beginning of wider industry challenges.

items.title: Brembo, Ningbo SAFE Form Joint Venture To Manufacture Motorcycle ABS Systems In India
items.summary: Brembo and China's Ningbo SAFE Brakes Systems have signed a joint venture agreement to establish a new company, BRSF Active Safety Solutions, focused on the production of anti-lock braking systems (ABS) for motorcycles in India. The venture aims to address growing demand for advanced braking technologies in the country's two-wheeler market, which accounts for up to 25 million registered vehicles annually.

items.title: Motovolt Deploys Over 200 MVS7 Electric Vehicles Through GBG EV Partnership in Delhi NCR
items.summary: Motovolt Mobility has expanded its partnership with electric vehicle fleet rental operator GBG EV, deploying more than 200 units of its MVS7 electric two-wheelers for last-mile delivery operations across Delhi NCR. The vehicles are equipped with battery-swapping technology supplied by Indofast.

items.title: Top Indian Tyre Makers Line Up Over ₹7,500 Crore Capex For FY27
items.summary: India’s leading tyre makers are preparing a fresh round of capital expenditure for FY27 and the years ahead, as capacity utilisation across key product categories moves close to peak levels and demand remains steady across replacement and original equipment channels. Apollo Tyres, CEAT, JK Tyre & Industries and Balkrishna Industries have together outlined large capex plans covering truck and bus radial tyres, pass...

items.title: Omega Seiki Mobility Integrates Honda e:Swap Battery Ecosystem With Rage+ Electric Cargo Three-Wheeler
items.summary: Omega Seiki Mobility (OSM) has announced the integration of Honda’s e battery-swapping ecosystem with its Rage+ electric cargo three-wheeler, expanding battery-swapping options for commercial electric vehicle operators in India. Under the arrangement, the OSM Rage+ will be compatible with Honda’s battery-swapping infrastructure, allowing users to exchange depleted batteries for fully charged units within minutes i...

items.title: Mahindra Crosses 70 Lakh Tractor Production Milestone Globally
items.summary: World’s largest tractor manufacturer by volume reaches another major milestone as FY26 sales exceed 5.26 lakh units The post Mahindra Crosses 70 Lakh Tractor Production Milestone Globally appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: UltraTech deploys 45 e-trucks for clinker transportation in northern India
items.summary: The initiative is expected to reduce more than 8,900 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and displace around 2.9 million litres of diesel consumption each year.

items.title: JLR eyes double-digit revenue growth, bets on North America as growth engine
items.summary: The luxury carmaker aims to lower its breakeven point to 300,000 units while gearing up for key launches, including the Range Rover Electric and next-generation Jaguar.

items.title: JLR ramps up cybersecurity, China focus after FY26 setback
items.summary: The luxury carmaker aims to reduce its breakeven volume to 300,000 units over two years as it strengthens cybersecurity, sharpens its China strategy and prepares for key EV launches.

items.title: China's BYD ramps up battery production in Brazil
items.summary: Chinese electric carmaker BYD is boosting battery production in Brazil. The company plans significant investment in energy storage systems to support Brazil's national grid. This expansion is part of a strategy to become Brazil's top car brand by 2030.

items.title: Upcoming Hyundai Sub 4m Electric SUV Spied – 2026 Diwali Launch
items.summary: It is expected that Hyundai's new sub-4-meter electric SUV could be launched by year end or in early 2027 The post Upcoming Hyundai Sub 4m Electric SUV Spied – 2026 Diwali Launch appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Citroen launches updated e-C3X electric crossover with BaaS model
items.summary: The company said the introductory BaaS pricing starts at ₹6.89 lakh, with battery charges of ₹2.26 per km. The standard range starts at ₹10.25 lakh.

items.title: Mercedes launches mass production of electric motor for high-performance AMG brand
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun series production of a new lightweight axial flux electric motor at its Berlin-Marienfelde plant. This innovative technology, designed to be lighter and more efficient than traditional motors, aims to address the challenges of electrifying high-performance AMG vehicles.

items.title: Force Motors Assembles 200,000th Mercedes-Benz Engine at Chakan Manufacturing Facility
items.summary: Force Motors Limited has completed the assembly of its 200,000th engine for Mercedes-Benz India at its dedicated powertrain manufacturing facility in Chakan, Pune. The milestone unit, a six-cylinder M256 engine, was allocated for installation into a Mercedes-Benz GLS 450 luxury SUV.

items.title: Dacia launches 2nd-generation Spring EV, retains focus on affordable electric mobility
items.summary: The Renault Group-owned brand said the new Spring will continue to offer a fully electric powertrain, four-seat configuration and practical boot space, staying true to Dacia's value-oriented approach.

items.title: India readies ₹12,000 crore push for local battery component manufacturing
items.summary: India is set to launch a new incentive scheme to boost local manufacturing of advanced cell battery components. This initiative aims to reduce import dependence for crucial materials like cathode and anode active materials, electrolysers, and copper foil separators.

items.title: Endurance Technologies Commences Commercial Output at Mindewadi Battery Pack Plant
items.summary: Endurance Technologies Limited has commenced commercial production of lithium ion battery packs at its newly constructed greenfield manufacturing facility in Mindewadi, located in the Maval taluka of Pune district, Maharashtra. The operational milestone follows a capital expenditure approval originally finalized by the company board of directors on 29 April 2025.

items.title: Marelli marks 300 F1 events with SDR, unveils upgraded system
items.summary: The system, developed with the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile, is installed on all Formula 1 cars and provides real-time data to support safety monitoring and regulatory compliance during races.

items.title: Customs Department Levies ₹97.6 Lakh Tax and Penalty Order on Uno Minda
items.summary: Uno Minda Limited has received an official assessment order from the Office of the Commissioner of Customs demanding payment for unpaid anti-dumping duties related to the import of industrial machinery. The regulatory disclosure, submitted to the domestic stock exchanges on June 17, 2026, outlines an aggregate monetary demand of 97.62 lakh rupees.
